title: Cleaning Invoice Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Bill house or office cleaning from your browser: per visit, hourly or per square foot. No sign-up. PDF, Word and Excel, with US price ranges and tax rules.
lede_html: Enter your visits and download a cleaning invoice as a PDF, Word or Excel file. No sign-up. The sample is one month of recurring house cleaning. Replace it with your client.

sample.pay: Card, Zelle or check to Spotless Home Care
sample.terms: Visits on 10, 17, 24 Oct and 7 Nov. Cancel with 24 hours notice, or a $40 lockout fee applies.

must_show.heading: What a cleaning invoice must show
must_show.intro_html: A cleaning invoice lists the visit dates and what each one covered. Dates and add-ons answer most client questions. The IRS names invoices among the supporting documents that you keep for your books.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on a cleaning job
rows: On a recurring plan, one invoice covers several dates. List them.
Standard, deep and move-out cleans have different prices.
Oven, fridge and windows get their own lines.
Texas taxes building cleaning. Ask your own state revenue office about your state.
Print it, so that a lockout fee is no surprise.

example.heading: Filled example: move-out deep clean
example.intro_html: A one-time job at sample prices.
example.after_html: The range for a move-in or move-out clean is $250–$550 from Tidy.

line_items.heading: Cleaning line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.
line_items.after_html: For scale: janitors and building cleaners had a median wage of $17.71 per hour in May 2025 (BLS). A rate billed to a client also covers supplies, travel and insurance.

rules.heading: Cleaning rules that touch the invoice

items.title: Tax on cleaning in Texas
items.html: The Texas Comptroller says tax is due on cleaning any building. A self-employed housekeeper employed by the household is exempt. Enter the combined rate on the form.

items.title: Collect, then remit
items.html: Texas also says that maid, janitorial and custodial operators should generally collect sales and use tax. Other states differ, so ask your own revenue office.

items.title: No formal education needed
items.html: BLS says that janitors and building cleaners typically do not need formal education to enter the occupation. Print a bond or insurance line only if you hold one.

faq.q: Do I send one invoice per visit or one per month?
faq.a: Either works. A monthly invoice with the dates in the notes means less paper for a recurring client.
Tips are not part of your price. Leave them off the invoice unless the client asks you to add one.

faq.q: Should I charge when a client locks me out?
faq.a: If your policy says so and the client saw it. Add a lockout line, and keep the message that shows that you came.

faq.q: Do I need the square footage on the invoice?
faq.a: Only if you price by it. For a visit price, write the bedrooms and bathrooms instead.
